# Stine Holmen

Stine Holmen is named as a consultant ("Konsulent") and patient representative ("Patientrepræsentant") in connection with the steering group for the Danish ADHD database [^src1]. She appears in a list of steering group members covering the period 1 April 2024 – 31 March 2025, alongside representatives from Denmark's five regions, relevant medical societies, patient organizations, and the Danish Healthcare Quality Program (Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut) [^src1]. No further biographical details, relationships, or claims about Stine Holmen are present in the corpus.
